row1.alt: Artisans finishing a piece by hand
row1.title: Pieces with a maker behind them
row1.body: Every lamp, frame and vessel we carry is shaped in small workshops across India. We work directly with artisans, so the craft stays honest and the details stay sharp.

row2.alt: Lighting collection: gold pendants, a chandelier, a wall sconce and table and floor lamps in a warm living room
row2.title: Light, texture and the art of a calm room
row2.body: Good interiors are built in layers: a warm pendant over the table, a sculptural lamp by the sofa, a frame that catches the eye. Our collections are designed to sit together, so it is easy to build a room that feels considered.
